title: Injective resolutions of a short exact sequence (horseshoe lemma)
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives, and let $0\to A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C\to0$ be a short exact sequence in $\mathcal A$. Then there exist injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] $s_A:A\to I_A^\bullet$, $s_B:B\to I_B^\bullet$, $s_C:C\to I_C^\bullet$ with $I_A^n=I_B^n=I_C^n=0$ for $n<0$, and morphisms of complexes $\alpha:I_A^\bullet\to I_B^\bullet$, $\beta:I_B^\bullet\to I_C^\bullet$, such that $\alpha^0\circ s_A=s_B\circ f$, $\beta^0\circ s_B=s_C\circ g$, and for every $n\geq0$ the sequence $0\to I_A^n\xrightarrow{\alpha^n}I_B^n\xrightarrow{\beta^n}I_C^n\to0$ is short exact. (One may moreover take $I_B^n=I_A^n\oplus I_C^n$ with $\alpha^n,\beta^n$ the inclusion and the projection.)

proof.text: Choose the canonical injective resolutions of S.X₁ and S.X₃ supplied by InjectiveResolution.of. Apply the stronger prescribed-endpoint horseshoe theorem to S and these resolutions. Its resulting middle resolution, complex maps, augmentation equalities, degreewise short exactness, and biproduct identifications are exactly the witnesses required here.

lean.statement: theorem exists_horseshoe_resolutions {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [EnoughInjectives C] (S : ShortComplex C) (hS : S.ShortExact) : ∃ (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (IB : InjectiveResolution S.X₂) (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃) (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ IB.cocomplex) (β : IB.cocomplex ⟶ IC.cocomplex), IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.f ≫ IB.ι ∧ IB.ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.g ≫ IC.ι ∧ ∃ (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0), ∀ n : ℕ, ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).ShortExact ∧ ∃ e : IB.cocomplex.X n ≅ IA.cocomplex.X n ⊞ IC.cocomplex.X n, α.f n ≫ e.hom = biprod.inl ∧ β.f n = e.hom ≫ biprod.snd
